title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Flame Design
summary: ACME Flame Design: normal and inverse spherical diffusion flames (ethylene and methane in the PSI objectives; ethylene and propane in the data table) to determine soot-inception and extinction limits as a function of flow rate, stoichiometric mixture fraction, inert dilution and pressure.

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator
summary: ACME BRE: porous burners emulate a burning solid to relate flammability in a quiescent atmosphere to material properties (O2 from 21 % to 40 %).

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Coflow Laminar Diffusion Flame
summary: ACME CLD Flame: weak, highly diluted methane and ethylene coflow flames; shape, liftoff, temperature and extinction limits for model validation.

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
summary: ACME E-FIELD Flames: effect of electric fields (up to 10 kV between burner and mesh) on ion current, flame response and soot in laminar gas-jet and coflow diffusion flames. The PSI record states it is not aimed at space applications.

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments-Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames
summary: ACME s-Flame: transient spherical diffusion flames, with and without soot, in ~21 % and ~30 % O2 atmospheres, to validate transport and chemical kinetics.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
summary: BASS-II: ignition, growth, spread and extinction limits of solid fuels (PMMA films, slabs and rods; SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric; Nomex; a wax candle) in low-speed forced flows of up to 40 cm/s, with ambient O2 lowered by nitrogen from about 22 % to 13.6 %.

title: Burning and Suppression of Solids
summary: BASS: initial solid-fuel campaign (PMMA, SIBAL, Nomex, Ultem, candle) in slow flow; relates the ground-based NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 to actual flammability in microgravity.

title: Cool Flames Investigation
summary: CFI: cool flames of n-dodecane droplets and blends with iso-dodecane between 0.5 and 5 atm; effects of helium dilution and droplet size on extinction.

title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test / Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test-2
summary: DAFT / DAFT-2: tests whether the particle counter used in SAME works in microgravity, using test dust instead of smoke.

title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
summary: Ground-based analysis of more than 1600 SPICE images to obtain temperature and soot fraction, and explain why soot differs between 1 g and 0 g.

title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
summary: Numerical model (flamelet generated manifolds) of concurrent flame spread over solids, validated against BASS.

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2
summary: FLEX-2: extends FLEX to practical fuels and binary mixtures, with O2 from 0.17 to 0.30 and pressure from 0.5 to 3 atm (ranges of conditions).

title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
summary: FLEX: methanol and heptane droplets; maps flammability limits (limiting oxygen index) and the effectiveness of gaseous suppressants (CO2, He) as a function of pressure.

title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I
summary: Saffire-I: large-scale fire (0.4 × 0.94 m SIBAL fabric) to measure how quickly fire grows and compare it with ground-based flammability testing.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-II
summary: Saffire-II: materials (silicone, SIBAL, PMMA, Nomex) burned in Cygnus to determine flammability limits in low gravity versus 1 g.

title: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-III
summary: Saffire-III: a large-scale SIBAL fire at 30 cm/s (concurrent and opposed flow) with thermocouples, radiometers, pressure, CO2 and O2 sensors and anemometers.

title: Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment-Reflight
summary: SAME-R: repeat of SAME; measures smoke particle sizes from heated spacecraft materials (pyrolysis) to inform detector design.

title: Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment
summary: SAME: smoke particle sizes from Teflon, Kapton, silicone, cotton wick and dibutyl phthalate in microgravity, for smoke detectors.

title: Structure and Liftoff In Combustion Experiment
summary: SLICE: structure and stability (flame liftoff) of laminar diffusion flames as a function of fuel, burner diameter and dilution.

title: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
summary: SPICE: smoke point (the condition at which a flame starts emitting soot) of jet flames with coflowing air in microgravity.

title: Utilization of the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment Data for Advanced Modeling and Simulation of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
summary: Numerical simulation of pyrolysis smoke growth using SAME data to quantify differences between smoke in 1 g and in microgravity.

title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
summary: CFD using FLEX data: how thermal and convective perturbations determine the fate of cool droplet flames.

title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation / Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
summary: Counterflow simulations and experiments with ozone to construct a cool-flame flammability-limit diagram, supported by FLEX.

title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
summary: ACME CFI-G: normal and inverse cool diffusion flames of ethane, propane and butane; in inverse flames the burner issues an oxidizer jet with up to about 85 % O2 (jet O2, not the chamber atmosphere).

title: Aerosol Sampling Experiment
summary: ASE: sampling particles from ISS air. Outside the Combustion Science area; provides context on background aerosols versus smoke.
